For the third term \( a_3 \) and the seventh term \( a_7 \), we have:
\( a_3 = a_1 + (3-1)d = a_1 + 2d = 10 \) (Equation 1)
\( a_7 = a_1 + (7-1)d = a_1 + 6d = 26 \) (Equation 2)

We can subtract Equation 1 from Equation 2 to find the value of \( d \):
\( (a_1 + 6d) - (a_1 + 2d) = 26 - 10 \)
\( 4d = 16 \)
\( d = 4 \)

Now, substitute the value of \( d = 4 \) into Equation 1 to find the value of \( a_1 \):
\( a_1 + 2(4) = 10 \)
\( a_1 + 8 = 10 \)
\( a_1 = 10 - 8 \)
\( a_1 = 2 \)
